title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics, parity fixes & version bumps
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs into parity for auth behavior, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics ahead of the next release. This PR standardizes default auth header handling across SDKs, consolidates retry/backoff configs with deterministic idempotency keys, improves streaming API ergonomics (consistent chunk framing + cancelation hooks), fixes several platform parity regressions identified during cross-SDK smoke tests, and bumps package versions to prepare for release. Changes are scoped to SDK surfaces only, with behavioral guards and compatibility shims where necessary to avoid breaking existing integrations.
commits: initial: unify auth header plumbing across SDKs
retries: add deterministic idempotency and backoff config (all SDKs)
streaming: normalize chunk framing and add cancel hook (python/ts/go)
parity: fix missing model param validation in TS SDK
docs: update migration notes and changelog entries
tests: add cross-sdk smoke and e2e for streaming and retries
patch_summary: Key changes: unified Authorization header lookup and precedence (env -> client config -> request header), consistent default retries with jittered exponential backoff and deterministic idempotency keys for idempotent calls, standardized streaming frames (metadata frame + data chunks) and explicit cancel() hook on stream objects, small API ergonomic tweaks: Python: StreamClient.close() -> cancel(), TS/Go: added onCancel hook and proper backpressure handling. Added compatibility shims for older callers and feature-flag guarded strict validation.
